name: tinyactors-website
description: What the site's pages load in the browser, vendored by the build into build/site/vendor/ (mise/website.rb, VENDOR): scxmljs's <scxml-view> for chart diagrams, and highlight.js (its browser ES modules) for code; and the platforms' icons the build inlines into the pages (render/site.xsl, f:platform): simple-icons (CC0) for Node.js, Bun, Python and C, lucide-static (ISC, the design system's icons) for browsers.
